data.case_title: Health insurance contribution increase – Musterquell Krankenkasse
data.title: Notice of increased health insurance contributions from Musterquell Krankenkasse
data.summary: Musterquell Krankenkasse informs Johanna Beispielacker that, from 1 January 2027, her monthly statutory health and long-term care insurance contributions (as a voluntarily insured member) will rise to €318.46, citing the fund's new supplementary contribution rate and her income shown in her 2025 tax assessment. The contribution continues to be debited on the 15th of the following month, and an objection (Widerspruch) can be filed within the deadline shown.
data.explanation: Your health insurer has increased your monthly contribution to €318.46 starting 1 January 2027. This happens automatically via the existing direct debit, due on the 15th of the following month, so you don't need to do anything to pay it. If you think the new amount is wrong, you have the right to file an objection (Widerspruch) with the fund; the app shows the exact deadline for this, calculated from when the letter is deemed delivered. If you miss that window, the new amount becomes final. Since contributions to statutory health and long-term care insurance are tax-deductible, keep this letter for your next tax return.
